intro: Let chat put Streamfog face lenses on your camera with a command or a channel point reward. One lens shows at a time; extra requests wait in a short line.

sections.title: 1. Lenses
sections.description: Add, remove, or rename lenses. Each line is one lens.
sections.notice: Format: Label | exact Streamfog lens name | !command | channel point reward title | seconds. The lens name must match Streamfog exactly. For a channel point reward, create it on Twitch or Kick first and type its exact title. Restart StreamBridge after changing commands.

sections.title: 2. Who can trigger lenses
sections.description: Commands work on every selected chat; channel point rewards work on Twitch and Kick.

sections.title: 3. Timing and limits
sections.description: Keep lenses short and spaced out so chat cannot spam your camera.
sections.notice: Channel point redemptions, moderators, and you skip cooldowns but still wait in line.

sections.title: 4. Chat replies
sections.description: Optional confirmations sent back to the chat that asked.
